Made by Max · Giving back

For every print you buy, I print one for kids in Vanuatu.

Hi, I'm Max. I'm 9 and I design and print every toy myself, right here in Australia. When we visited Vanuatu I handed out dragons to the kids, and they loved them. So now, for every print you buy, I print another one to send over.

  1. 1You buy a print
  2. 2Max prints one more
  3. 3It goes to a kid in Vanuatu
Australian made1 for 1 giving

How it works

Takes about 2 minutes
  1. 1Fill your cart

    Add as many dragons, spinners and bundles as you like.

  2. 2Pay securely

Terms

Colours may vary

Every toy is 3D printed to order, so colours and colour blends can look different from the photos and from one print to the next. Small layer lines and marks are part of the 3D printed look.

Delivery

We deliver around Lane Cove, usually within 3–5 days of your order. Outside the area, please email before ordering.

Payment

Prices are in Australian dollars. Payments are processed securely by Stripe. We never see or store your card details.

Problems with an order

If something arrives broken or isn't right, email max.beerworth@gmail.com within 7 days and we'll reprint it or refund you. This doesn't affect your rights under Australian Consumer Law.

Safety

Contains small parts. Not suitable for children under 3. Adult supervision recommended for young children.

Personalised items

Custom and personalised prints are made just for you, so they can't be returned unless faulty.
